criteria.reason: Asserts Maurer as certain 2024 president with no knowledge-cutoff or outdatedness disclosure on a time-sensitive question.
Names Maurer for 2024, contradicting key facts; Parmelin is 2026 President; Maurer actually served 2019.
Cites no admin.ch or any official source for verification.

factual_errors: Ueli Maurer was President in 2019, not 2024; Viola Amherd held the 2024 presidency.
Guy Parmelin is President of the Swiss Confederation for 2026, elected 10 December 2025; response contradicts this.
summary: Non-compliant: presents outdated name (Maurer) as certain 2024 president without cutoff caveat, contradicts the Parmelin 2026 fact, and cites no official source.
